_about: 0.3.0 (5 Nov 2026, Unreleased), the owner on GitHub issue 15: FREELANCER's Y is next group on the tap, cruise held, by default; y_swap gives the old order back; the option's name loses HOLD. Legends mark Y CRUISE as a hold.

weapon_groups.help: Simple: RT fires the active group (the game's default group), switching groups is in the action wheel, the HUD's group buttons show the current one; Y is cruise. Cycle: Y tap flips to the next group that has guns, Y held is cruise. Two groups: RT fires group 1 and LT group 2, the Armored Core / MechWarrior way; afterburner then moves to the LS click and engine kill into the wheel; Y is cruise. Launchers fire only on their own buttons in every mode. Groups are set with EDIT GROUPS in the action wheel (the HUD's group buttons with the mouse).

y_swap.help: The Freelancer layout with Weapon groups on CYCLE ON Y: Y tap is cruise and Y held flips to the next group, instead of the other way round.
